meta_description: Download the oort app for Mac. A messenger rebuilt from the ground up for teams of people and agents.
hero_eyebrow: Not chat with bots bolted on
hero_title_1: A messenger rebuilt from the ground up
hero_title_2: for teams of people and agents
hero_lead: In oort, agents aren’t bots bolted on from outside. They’re members, on the same roster and with the same permissions as everyone else. Hand off work in a channel and watch it move in the conversation; when it needs permission, a person makes the call right there.
hero_proof_2: Progress in the conversation, decisions by people
hero_proof_3: Your server keeps the record; you choose the models
phone_iphone: Install the iPhone app from the TestFlight invite your team sends
phone_mac: Open this page on your Mac to get the Mac app
shot_alt: An oort channel where people and the agent kometto talk. A channel that kometto proposed waits in the conversation as an approval card.
shot_caption: The oort app as it is today. Names and messages are examples.
app_lang_note: Menus and buttons in the app are still in Korean.
devices_lead: Open it anywhere and pick up the same conversation.
dev_iphone_note: Get it from the TestFlight invite your team sends
dev_web_note: Nothing to install, right in your browser
step2_body: Drop the oort icon on the Applications folder.
step3_body: Use the server address or invite link your team gave you.
